title: Dollar Tree Recalls Burn Relief Gel Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The burn relief gel contains lidocaine, posing a poisoning risk if swallowed. Units: About 325,000.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR XP Turbo Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicles' oil drain line can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,230 vehicles.

title: Polaris Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steering pitman arm or drag link can crack and result in a loss of steering, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 4,700.

title: Basler Electric Recalls Transformers Due to Fire, Shock Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The circuit breaker in the transformer can fail to trip, posing fire and electrical shock hazards. Units: About 11,900.

title: The Craftsman Brand Recalls Blower/Vacs Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The blower/vac's motor can catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 74,000.

title: Jofran Recalls Cement Table Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A stress fracture can form in the table, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 300.

title: Kubota Recalls Utility Vehicle Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Combustible debris can make contact with the exhaust manifold and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,500.

title: Limoss Recalls Battery Power Packs for Power Recliners and Lift Chairs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery power packs can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: Technical Consumer Products Recalls LED Lamps Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: Water can enter the lamp in wet location applications, posing an electric shock hazard to the user. Units: About 25,000 (in addition about 1,350 were sold in Canada).

title: Cost Plus World Market Recalls Reading Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front leg on reading chairs sold without front leg support blocks can bend or break, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 2,700.

title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Mountain Bikes with OEM Carbon Fiber Seatposts Due to Risk of Injury, Fall Hazards
summary: The carbon seat post originally sold with the bicycle can crack and break, posing injury and fall hazards to the rider. Units: 645.

title: North Central Industries Recalls Fireworks Fountains Due to Burn and Injury Hazard
summary: The rear plug of the candle can dislodge while lit, posing burn and fire hazards to the user if the user is holding the device. Units: About 2,600.

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls Cordless Drills Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: An internal switching mechanism can become stuck in the "on" position and overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 1.7 million units.

title: Breville Recalls Pressure Cookers Due to Risk of Burns
summary: The sealing gasket can be incorrectly inserted upside down on the lid which can allow the unexpected release of built-up pressure. This poses a risk of burns to the user or consumers nearby. Units: About 35,600.

title: Carrier Recalls to Repair Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners, Heat Pumps Including Previously Recalled Units Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power cord plug can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 285,000 (About 185,000 were previously recalled in November 2007).

title: John Deere Recalls Zero Turn Lawn Mowers Due to Risk of Fire, Serious Injury or Death (Recall Alert)
summary: A fuel hose could have been cut during manufacturing, allowing fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 150.

title: Victorian Trading Company Recalls Tealight Holders Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The diameter of the hole in the top hat is too small, which can allow heat to build up and create cracks in the surface, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,000 (in addition, 13 were sold in Canada).

title: Ace Bayou Reannounces Recall of Bean Bag Chairs Due to Low Rate of Consumer Response; Two Child Deaths Previously Reported; Consumers Urged to Install Repair
summary: The recalled bean bag chairs have two zippers, including an outer zipper that does not have a pull tab and another zipper directly underneath that zipper. title: Casablanca Recalls Ceiling Fans Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The fan motor and attached blades can separate from the adapter when operating in reverse updraft mode, causing the fan motor and blades to fall, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 30,000.

title: Focus Bicycles Recalls Izalco Max Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The headset could cause the carbon-fiber fork steer tube to crack, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 470 (an additional 31 sold in Canada).

title: S.R. Smith Recalls Pool Lifts Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Welds securing the lift base plate and/or mast can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,800 Splash! and 40 PAL Hi/Lo and Spa lifts.

title: Skip Hop Recalls Crib Mobiles Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The strap attaching the product to the crib rail can break, posing an injury hazard if the product falls on the infant in the crib. Units: About 3,500 (an additional 850 were sold in Canada).

title: Kawasaki Expands Recall of Teryx and Teryx4 Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Sticks or other debris can break through the vehicle's floor board and protrude into the foot rest area, posing an injury hazard to the operator and front passenger. Units: About 19,500 (an additional 11,000 were recalled for the same hazard in July 2014 and 7,000 for a different hazard in August 20

title: Lithonia Lighting Recalls Light Fixtures Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The metal hub used to mount the light fixtures to the ceiling can break and allow the fixture to fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury from impact. Units: About 6,500.

title: KTM North America Recalls Competition Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Under extreme riding conditions, fuel can escape from the tank breather assembly. This poses a risk of fire and injury to the rider. Units: About 550.

title: Origin8 Recalls Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The frame on the folding bicycles can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,600.

title: Macy's Recalls Martha Stewart Stainless Steel Cookware; Injury Hazard with Frying Pans
summary: The metal discs that cover the frying pan's rivets can pop off and hit consumers, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 121,000.
